description:
The National Kisan Mazdoor Dhan Suraksha Yojana (NKMDY) is a welfare scheme aimed at providing financial assistance to farmers and agricultural laborers in India. 

The objective of the scheme is to enhance the financial security of farmers and laborers by providing them with a safety net against economic vulnerabilities. 

The scheme offers direct cash transfers to eligible beneficiaries to support their livelihoods and improve their economic conditions. 

Eligibility for the scheme includes small and marginal farmers as well as agricultural laborers who meet specific income criteria set by the government. 

The application process typically involves submitting an application form along with required documents to the local agricultural office or designated authority. 

The timeline for disbursement of benefits is usually quarterly but may vary based on the specific guidelines issued by the implementing agency. 

The scheme is implemented by the Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare in collaboration with state governments. 

Additional details on the scheme may include awareness programs and workshops to educate beneficiaries about the benefits and application process.
